overview: A row of buttons on every chest, sort, dump, restock, take all, and sixteen colours of paint for a chest that is already standing.

1.1.0: Shulker boxes get the same row of buttons as a chest, sorted and filled where they stand.
A box with no room to swing its lid still refuses to open, and the piglins take it personally.
1.0.1: A chest can be shared with somebody by command.
A take-all stops at the end of your pack, not in armour, offhand and unshown slots.
A vanilla client keeps vanilla's chest.
A server can set aside places where nothing is to be locked.
1.0.0: Sort, deposit, restock, take all and top up, on chests, barrels, chest minecarts and boats.
A sort button in your own inventory as well.
Sorting fills the hotbar rather than tidying it, and you can lock it.
Sixteen dyes paint a chest already placed: no recipe, no new item, no emptying it first.
The paint comes back off when the chest is broken.
